title: DR-3: franking_signature_key = franking_agent
description: protocol-06 §10.2 registers franking_signature_key 0x0021 while §5.4 calls it franking_agent. Treat as one component 0x0021 with FrankingAgentData.
notes: 2026-11-04: CONFIRMED by protocol-07 (the published text now matches this reading); see mimid-1wgh.5.76.
